# Documentation guidance

Preserve the authority boundaries in [README.md](../../README.md),
[GOVERNANCE.md](../../GOVERNANCE.md), and
[docs/architecture/README.md](../../docs/architecture/README.md). Documentation
must distinguish normative expectations, empirical observations, operational
plans, physical attempts, evidence assessments, derived findings, and research
inference. Link to the canonical program or architecture source rather than
copying status or policy that will drift. Verify local links and reproduction
commands without executing expensive or mutating workflows.
